source: ADB-supported agricultural productivity project leaflet, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកកួរ" [Yard-long bean/cowpea cultivation], 2002
text: This earlier (2002) ADB-supported agricultural productivity project leaflet covers the same crop, yard-long bean/cowpea (សណ្តែកកួរ), as a compact 2-page farmer sheet. Content parallels Source A in scope (land preparation, planting, basic care, and harvest for a vegetable-pod legume) but was produced roughly a decade earlier under a different donor program; specific numeric fertilizer/spacing values in this source were not as clearly legible as in the more detailed Source C and are not reproduced here beyond what could be confidently read. The leaflet's core message — that yard-long bean is grown and picked as a fresh green vegetable pod on a repeated-harvest basis rather than as a dried pulse — is consistent with the other two sources for this product.
